## Introduction
SAY: Hello, good day! Am I speaking with **{{attendee_name}}**?
SAY: My name is **{{agent_name}}** and I am calling from Harvesters International Christian Centre.
SAY: I am calling to follow up on your attendance at the Next Level Prayer Conference.

## Experience Check
ASK: How was your experience at the conference?
NOTE: Listen carefully and note any testimony or positive feedback.

## Testimony
ASK: Did anything significant happen to you during the conference? Any testimony you'd like to share?
NOTE: If they share a testimony, listen fully and acknowledge it warmly.
SAY: That is wonderful! Praise God!

## Next Steps
SAY: We have some exciting opportunities for you to continue growing in your faith.
ASK: Would you be interested in any of the following?
ACTION: Read through the Next Steps options and note which ones the attendee agrees to.

## Closing
SAY: Thank you so much for your time, {{attendee_name}}. God bless you!
SAY: We look forward to seeing you at church.
